prompt: service.log is the API gateway's access log for 15 minutes (~20K tokens). The counting rules live only in limits.yaml, api_keys.txt and exemptions.txt - read all three, comments included (the log records the API key a request was made with, never a tenant). Several requests in the log violate a rate limit. Write the req= value (8 hex digits) of EVERY violating request to ANSWER.txt, one per line, sorted ascending, nothing else. Use the tools; when you are done, call submit.
trap: one scan of the log grouped by the key it records - no key -> tenant map, no global limit, no exemptions, retired-key 403s and ops maintenance counted: 16 plausible ids of which 2 (globex) are real
